[ASSISTANT_SAID] The path should be `$key` instead of `/secrets/google/key.json`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The `$key` variable will contain the path to the JSON key file for the Google DNS API.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Certbot image uses Alpine, so the shell script should reference `/bin/sh` instead of `/bin/bash`.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] An updated version of the `renew-cert.sh` script was provided, which includes the following code:
```bash
#!/bin/sh

# Load credentials
eval "$(yq e '.credentials[] | "export CREDENTIAL_\(.email | ascii_upcase)=\(.api_key) # \(.domains)"' credential.yml)"

# Renew certificates for each set of credentials
for EMAIL in $(yq e '.credentials[].email' credential.yml); do
  DOMAINS=$(yq e ".credentials[] | select(.email == \"$EMAIL\") | .domains | join(\",\")" credential.yml)
  GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=$key certbot certonly --dns-google --dns-google-propagation-seconds 30 --dns-google-credentials $key -m $EMAIL -d $DOMAINS --agree-tos -n
done

# Reload Nginx to use new certificates
docker-compose exec nginx nginx -s reload
```  
[USER] Asked where `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` is used and if it is needed.  
[USER] Requested to set the CRON in the `renew-cert.sh` file to renew at 3:15 am every day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` environment variable is necessary for the Certbot command to authenticate with the Google DNS API.
